mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( user_id, room_id, accommodation_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, guest_count, total_price, status, payment_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{roomId}, #{accommodationId}, #{checkInDate}, #{checkOutDate}, #{guestCount}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{paymentStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.name AS user_name, u.email AS user_email, u.phone AS user_phone, rm.name AS room_name, a.title AS accommodation_title, a.accommodation_id, DATEDIFF(r.check_out_date, r.check_in_date) AS nights FROM reservations r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN accommodations a ON rm.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT r.* FROM reservations r JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN accommodations a ON rm.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id WHERE a.host_id = #{hostId}

SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE (check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) OR (check_out_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) OR (check_in_date <= #{startDate} AND check_out_date >= #{endDate})
